sections.text: I'll Do My Best to Guide Everyone...

-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 520. Deal magic damage (Dark) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Lethargy for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Constriction. The next Ability used will change from targeting all to a single target (except for certain Abilities).
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Anguish Collapse (Ability Power decreases by 50 when attacking an enemy not in Break, applies Grief with a 10% to chance to increase damage received by 50%, disables Unison gauge filling effects) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 120 seconds.
Water and Dark Defense from Unison Damage +600
